_readme: Photo slots. src = web file in static/img/photos (1600 px + a -800 version, made without GPS/camera data). status: 'trajno' = keep, 'privremeno' = placeholder until a 2026 photo of the same thing exists. source = original file on the owner's desktop. Empty src shows a grey placeholder with the todo text. Never use stock photos.
